title: Launch checklist — Streaming + Tool Calling + Structured Output examples refresh
body:
Owner (launch driver): Talia Benson (PMM/Program Mgmt)
Release coordinator: Connor O’Brien
Primary reviewers: Monica Patel (SDK), Elliot Price (Docs), Nikhil Sharma (PM), Dev Patel (Support)
Target launch window: Week of 2025-03-10 (Tue/Thu), contingent on PM-413 support matrix sign-off

---
GO/NO-GO INPUTS (must be green before publish)

[ ] PM terminology + positioning approved (PM-412)
    - Public terms: “structured output (JSON schema)”, “tool calling”, “streaming deltas/events”
    - No references to “JSON mode” unless explicitly called out as alias in compatibility notes
    Owner: Nikhil Sharma / Henry Cho

[ ] Model support matrix finalized + included in structured output docs (PM-413)
    - Clear language: guarantees vary by model family; validation recommended; fallback/retry guidance present
    Owner: Wei Chen / Applied ML reviewer

[ ] Cross-SDK parity check completed against event model conventions
    - Python/TS/Go examples match canonical patterns for:
      - message assembly from deltas
      - tool_call partial args accumulation
      - parallel tool calls + tool-result messages
      - structured output: validate + safe retry
    Owner: Ibrahim Khan

[ ] CI snippet sync check is passing in monorepo (redwood#14621)
    Owner: Sahana Iyer

[ ] Docs site code-tab selector regression confirmed fixed in prod/staging (INT-3321, redwood-docs#534)
    Owner: Elliot Price

---
1) DOCS PUBLISH CHECKLIST (redwood-docs)

Target PRs:
- Streaming guide + code tabs: redwood-docs#512
- Tool calling docs + known pitfalls: redwood-docs#519
- Structured output guide: redwood-docs#527
- Code-tab UI fix: redwood-docs#534

Pre-merge:
[ ] Verify code blocks are copy/paste runnable (all three languages)
    - Confirm imports + client init
    - Confirm env var names used match quickstarts + README
    - Confirm model names are consistent and not deprecated
    Owner: Wei Chen

[ ] Link check: no broken internal anchors; redirects configured per migration notes
    - Ensure old page URLs redirect and search indexing is not broken
    Owner: Docs Eng

[ ] Ensure “Known pitfalls” section includes top support issues:
    - partial tool args mid-stream (SUP-18421)
    - structured output invalid JSON + validation/retry (SUP-18436)
    - TS type mismatch/tool result shape (SUP-18452)
    Owner: Dev Patel + Wei Chen

[ ] Confirm docs call out OpenAI-compat differences where relevant (redwood-openai-compat#881)
    Owner: Brian Murphy

Publish steps:
[ ] Merge docs PRs to main (order: #534, #512, #519, #527)
[ ] Trigger docs build + deploy (standard docs pipeline)
[ ] Post-deploy spot-check (prod):
    - Streaming page: code tabs render, copy button works, line wraps not mangled
    - Tool calling page: parallel tool example formatting correct
    - Structured output page: schema block renders + JSON validation guidance visible
    Owner: Elliot Price

---
2) SDK RELEASE CHECKLIST (cut versions + release notes)

Version targets (proposed; adjust if another release is already queued):
- redwood-sdk-python: v1.18.0
- redwood-sdk-typescript: v0.31.0
- redwood-sdk-go: v0.17.0

Python (redwood-sdk-python)
Relevant PRs: #2874, #2881, #2890
[ ] Confirm examples run against current Hosted API without feature flags
[ ] Confirm golden transcript tests stable in CI (flake mitigation notes in #2881)
[ ] Confirm structured output helper usage is “example-only” (no implication of required API features)
[ ] Prepare CHANGELOG blurb (see template below)
[ ] Tag + publish release
Owner: Monica Patel / Sabrina James

TypeScript (redwood-sdk-typescript)
Relevant PRs: #1932, #1940, #1951
[ ] Confirm updated tool calling types compile under strict TS
[ ] Confirm streaming sample handles:
    - delta text
    - partial tool args
    - final message assembly
[ ] Confirm runtime validation guidance included (and not overly verbose in snippet)
[ ] Prepare CHANGELOG blurb
[ ] Publish to npm
Owner: Dana Lo

Go (redwood-sdk-go)
Relevant PRs: #744, #752, #761
[ ] Confirm streaming consumer loop sample is minimal-footgun:
    - handles disconnect/retry guidance
    - accumulates tool args
    - assembles final response
[ ] Confirm structured output example validates JSON and shows retry path
[ ] Prepare CHANGELOG blurb
[ ] Tag + publish module
Owner: Mateusz Zielinski

SDK changelog blurb template (copy/paste)
- “Updated streaming examples to use the canonical event model (deltas + final assembly) and added robust handling for partial tool-call arguments.”
- “Refreshed tool calling examples (including parallel tool calls + tool-result messages) to match Redwood’s supported semantics.”
- “Added structured output (JSON schema) examples with validation and safe fallback/retry guidance.”
- “No breaking API changes; examples updated for clarity and parity across languages.”

---
3) EXAMPLES + QUICKSTARTS PUBLISH CHECKLIST

redwood-examples
PRs: #311 (streaming + tool calling runnable samples), #318 (structured output sample)
[ ] Confirm README steps work end-to-end (fresh clone, env var set, run)
[ ] Confirm expected output blocks match current model behavior
[ ] Confirm tool calling sample demonstrates:
    - multiple tools
    - parallel calls (if supported by the model)
    - tool-result message flow
[ ] Confirm structured output sample demonstrates:
    - JSON schema constraints
    - validation failure path + retry
Owner: Renee Sullivan / Sabrina James

redwood-quickstarts
PRs: #204 (agentic workflow refresh), #212 (README updates)
[ ] Smoke test templates (Node/Python/Go) using standard env vars
    - Record exact commands used + expected console output (keep short)
[ ] Confirm template references docs pages (new URLs) and not deprecated ones
[ ] Confirm “Known pitfalls” link included where appropriate
Owner: Jean-Paul Laurent

---
4) SUPPORT ENABLEMENT (must complete before announcements)

[ ] Internal support brief (30 min) scheduled + deck/notes shared
    Audience: Support, Solutions Engineering, on-call DevEx
    Owner: Dev Patel

[ ] Update macros / internal KB entries
    - Partial tool args: recommended accumulation strategy; don’t parse args until tool_call_end/final
    - Structured output parse errors: validate; retry with “return ONLY valid JSON…”; fallback to non-streaming for strict parsing
    - Streaming disconnect: recommend retry w/ idempotency key if available; log stream_disconnect metric
    Owner: Priya Shah / Owen Phillips

[ ] “Top issues + fixes” doc posted in #support and pinned for 2 weeks
    Include links to the new docs pages + runnable examples
    Owner: Dev Patel

[ ] Solutions Eng field note updated (for SEs)
    - Short section: “What Redwood guarantees vs what the model guarantees”
    - Emphasize validation as best practice
    Owner: Markus Klein

---
5) RELEASE COMMS (external + internal)

Internal:
[ ] #announcements post drafted + approved (Slack thread: devex/1739341100)
[ ] #eng-releases note with SDK versions + links (Slack thread: eng-releases/1739596008)
Owner: Connor O’Brien

External (lightweight):
[ ] Docs “What’s new” blurb updated (if applicable)
[ ] Optional: small blog snippet / changelog post (DevRel)
Owner: Renee Sullivan

Comms checklist:
[ ] Include direct links to:
    - Streaming guide
    - Tool calling guide
    - Structured output guide
    - Runnable examples repo
    - Quickstart template
[ ] Include one concrete “copy/paste” snippet per language OR point to docs code tabs
[ ] Include a “If you hit X, do Y” mini troubleshooting section

---
6) POST-LAUNCH MONITORING (first 72 hours + week 1)

Metrics / signals to watch:
[ ] Support tickets tagged: streaming, tool-calling, structured-output
    - Goal: reduce repeats of SUP-18421/SUP-18436 patterns
    Owner: Dev Patel

[ ] Docs analytics (page views + copy button usage if tracked)
    - Streaming/tool calling/structured output pages
    - Watch for high exit rate on streaming page (potential confusion)
    Owner: Elliot Price

[ ] SDK issue trackers
    - Watch for new issues indicating examples don’t run on latest versions
    - Prioritize “example fails to compile/run” as P0
    Owner: Monica Patel / Dana Lo / Mateusz Zielinski

[ ] CI + smoke tests
    - Monitor any failures related to golden streaming transcripts (ENG-4822)
    - Monitor new counters added for smoke validation (redwood#14645):
      - stream_disconnect
      - tool_call_partial_args
      - structured_output_validation_fail
    Owner: Sahana Iyer

Day 2 follow-ups (if needed):
[ ] Patch docs wording if terminology confusion reappears
[ ] Add an additional callout box if customers mis-handle incremental JSON during streaming
[ ] If a model family shows frequent schema violations: add a documented fallback (non-streaming or more constrained prompt) + update support macro
Owner: Wei Chen / Ibrahim Khan / Dev Patel

---
DEFINITION OF DONE (launch considered complete)
- Docs pages live, stable, and link-checked
- SDK releases published with examples matching docs
- Runnable examples + quickstarts confirmed via smoke tests
- Support enablement completed (brief + macros + pinned post)
- Monitoring runbook executed for 72 hours; no high-volume “broken snippet” regressions

Notes / open questions (keep updated):
- Waiting on final wording from PM-413 for the structured output model support matrix (as of 2025-03-08)
- Confirm whether parallel tool calls should be shown as default or “advanced” (docs currently label as advanced; revisit if confusion persists)
- If we see recurring JSON streaming parse attempts, consider adding a dedicated “Don’t parse until final” callout on all streaming pages
